blocks.text: Zscaler Client Connector provides users access to Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Digital Experience (ZDX), and Zscaler Deception services. Zscaler Service Entitlement allows you to select which group of users or device groups can enroll into the ZPA, ZDX, or Zscaler Deception services. By default, ZIA enrollment is always enabled for all users.
Service entitlements provide the following benefits and allow you to:

blocks.item: Assign users and device groups to the subscribed Zscaler services.
Control which users or device groups within your organization are assigned to a Zscaler service.

blocks.heading: About the Zscaler Service Entitlement Page

blocks.text: On the Zscaler Service Entitlement page, (Administration > Client Connector Entitlement), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Enable ZDX for a group of users.
Enable Zscaler Deception for a group of users.
Enable Zscaler Deception for device groups.
Enable ZPA for a group of users.
Configure ZPA machine tunnel for all devices.

blocks.text: If you do not see the Zscaler Service Entitlement page in the menu, your organization may not have the proper subscriptions.
